name: Kaiping Diaolou and Villages
description: In Kaiping, in China's Guangdong province, rice fields are dotted with tall fortified towers called diaolou. Families who had made money abroad built them in the late 19th and early 20th centuries as refuges from bandits, and many are topped with a mix of Chinese and Western flourishes. Twenty towers across four village groups are inscribed, and they stand in stone, brick, rammed earth or concrete.
